title: Digital health adherence: concept- and data-driven evidence - interview study
summary:
DEKODE aims to develop an adherence toolkit that maps out the key factors for the use of digital health applications (DHA) from the perspective of all parties involved (users, providers, health insurance funds, developers, among others). At the same time, practical strategies for increasing evidence-based adherence are to be developed for developers and prescribers.

To achieve these goals, the project will first (1) develop a precise definition of adherence in the context of DHA that takes into account the perspectives of patients, providers, manufacturers, and payers. Building on this, (2) measurement criteria and standards for adherence to DHA will be developed and tested, followed by (3) the elaboration of a comprehensive adherence concept (toolkit) that systematically brings together the influencing factors and consequences of high versus low adherence.
conditions: All relevant indications for Digital Health Applications

interventions.name:

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients: Prospective use of a DiGA
Providers: Authorization to prescribe a DiGA / Age between 18 and 99 years.
Developers: Currently operating an approved DiGA, or intend to seek approval for a DiGA / Have previously operated a DiGA that has since been delisted. Age between 18 and 99 years.
Health insurance funds: Familiar with the topic of DiGAs / Age between 18 and 99 years.
Other political actors: Substantively engaged with the topic of DiGA / Age between 18 and 99 years.
Exclusion criteria:
Non-fulfillment of the inclusion criteria
